name: Pulse Sync
author: ESC_CODE
description: Syncs the OP-1 to an analog pulse clock on its line input, so a drum machine, sequencer or modular clock can set the tempo. It reads 24, 48 or 96 PPQ, or quarter to thirty-second note pulses, and turns them into the OP-1's 24 PPQ MIDI clock. Pick the left, right or both channels for the clock, and audio can come in on the other side.
credits: op1r inspired its split of clock and audio across the line input's two channels
